Killzone 3 // Unofficial PC Port (static recompilation)

A Windows x64 port of the 2011 PS3 game, made by static recompilation: the game's PowerPC and SPU code is translated to C ahead of time and compiled into a native PC program, so no CPU emulator runs at play time. The GPU is still translated as it runs (RSX to Direct3D 12); native replacements come step by step.

Status: Partly playable

You need your own copy of the game. This project ships no game code, data, assets or keys.

A first release that calls itself playable waits for the release criteria.

See the statusSource on GitHub

About the port

by the project · how it works · 56 port features

The port is built on ps3recomp (MIT): the PPU code and the game's SPU programs are lifted to C, the PS3 system libraries the game calls are reimplemented, and the game's RSX command stream is replayed on Direct3D 12. The game's archive is read in place from your dump. It is tested on Windows x64 under Proton; a native Linux build is planned. What comes next: the roadmap.

Full status

Install

Not released yet.

The planned release is a Windows installer and a portable zip. They check your own disc dump and the 1.14 update, then recompile and build the game's code on your own machine with a bundled compiler, with one progress bar and a full install log. Nothing of the game is shipped or downloaded; your dump is read where it is, never copied.

Until then you can build the port from source: building. Releases will appear on the releases page.

What goes online

Nothing, unless you ask for it: an optional new-version check (one anonymous request to GitHub, only when you turn it on) and, planned, opt-in crash reports, an opt-in Discord status (still being tested; the Discord app on your PC shows it, the port sends nothing over the network for it) and online multiplayer only through a self-hosted server you choose. The full list is in the README.

The original PS3 game's online play is kept running by the PS Rewired community (their Killzone 3 page). This port is not affiliated with or endorsed by PS Rewired and does not connect to their servers.

Install questions: Q&A discussions.
